title: Finite Bayes Correlated Equilibrium, Information Expansions and Information Order
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: Bergemann–Morris Theorem 1 for arbitrary finite players and states with heterogeneous action and original-signal spaces: a normalized decision rule is obedient if and only if a finite marginal-preserving information expansion supports a valid mixed Bayes–Nash strategy profile inducing its joint law. The recommendation expansion and the converse for arbitrary extra signals and independent behavioral randomization are proved.
